text:
anna (partnerships): Heads-up team — ArborCompute asked for a focused smoke + tuning window to validate perf/W and throughput for rdx-13b on their A120 card. They want a short public results page and a marketplace blurb if numbers look good. Can we scope telemetry and a minimal workload matrix?

jason (perf-eng): Thumbs up. Proposal: two phases. Phase A: smoke (30m) at three seq points [128, 512, 1024] single-client QPS sweep to find knee. Phase B: tuning (multi-hour) kernel flag sweeps and perf/W sampling.

sara (eng-runtime): For telemetry we need host power (RAPL), PMBus per-board, per-kernel op latencies, and batcher-level tail-lat distribution. Sampling: 5Hz for RAPL, 10Hz for PMBus OK. Will add a small harness to emit JSON lines to s3.

kevin @ArborCompute: We can supply PMBus + probe harness and a small firmware patch that disables power-smoothing on card (recommended for steady-state readings). Kit ships week of May 10. We'll provide wiring guide and CSV power profiles.

leo (lab-ops): Blocked lab-rack-8 May 12-13 for hands-on. Need a 2hr install window May 11 for the probe wiring and PSU checks. Will set BIOS to "performance" preset and capture a full hw snapshot before runs.

calendar-bot: Event created: "ArborCompute: smoke + perf/W tuning" May 11 14:00 PT (probe install). May 12 09:00-17:00 PT (smoke + tuning).

anna (partnerships): Action list:
- sara: telemetry schema draft + harness script (jsonl lines, s3 path); include field names for pmbus.voltage, pmbus.power, host.rapl.package, kernel.op_ms, batch.lat_p95
- jason: workload matrix + perf/W calc method (normalized to TDP and raw W)
- kevin: probe kit ETA and firmware note (any recommended card knobs)
- leo: confirm lab image and serial console access, snapshot link

jason (perf-eng): Quick note on perf/W: i'll calculate both instantaneous perf/W and steady-state perf/W averaged over last 10 minutes of run. We'll annotate if kernel flags changed.

sara (eng-runtime): For tuning runs we'll flip these flags one at a time: "enable_streaming_kernels=1", "use_tensor_core_accel=1", and an optional "kernel_sched_policy=compact". I'll log git sha for runtime and kernel.

kevin @ArborCompute: Good. One ask from our side: include per-card thermal throttling events in the logs (we'll send a small parser).

leo (lab-ops): Confirmed image: redwood-lab-2026-05-01. I'll drop install notes in the runbook at https://internal.redwood/lab/rack8/arbor (internal).

anna (partnerships): Great. I'll draft a 2-paragraph marketplace blurb template after we have validated numbers; won't publish without signoff from legal & marketing.

jason (perf-eng): ack. I'll upload a minimal CSV workload matrix to s3://redwood-perf/interop/arbor/1758887777/workload_matrix.csv by EOD Thurs.

sara (eng-runtime): ack. Opening PR with telemetry_schema_v2.json and harness example.

kevin @ArborCompute: ack. Kit ETA May 9 (arrive May 10 in lab). I'll DM install contact.

anna (partnerships): Thanks all 60a Keeping thread for quick updates only. We'll create postmortem/results doc after runs.
